examples.en: caustic soda (= a chemical used for cleaning things )
examples.zh: 苛性鈉，燒鹼

examples.en: She’ll race if she gets medical clearance from her doctor.
examples.zh: 如果取得了醫生的許可，她就會參加比賽。

examples.en: Morris did not have a security clearance .
examples.zh: 莫里斯沒有安全審查許可。

examples.en: They heard a commotion downstairs.
examples.zh: 他們聽見樓下一陣騷動。

examples.en: Everyone looked to see what was causing the commotion .
examples.zh: 大家都在看是什麼引起了喧鬧。

examples.en: Drinking water is good for the complexion.
examples.zh: 喝水讓氣色變好。

examples.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
examples.zh: 通告一定要貼在顯眼的地方。

examples.en: a bird with conspicuous white markings
examples.zh: 一種長有醒目白斑的鳥

examples.en: Caffeine constricts the blood vessels in your body.
examples.zh: 咖啡因會使體內的血管收縮。

examples.en: Linda’s throat constricted and she started to cry.
examples.zh: 琳達喉嚨發緊，哭了起來。

examples.en: craters on the moon’s surface
examples.zh: 月球表面的坑

examples.en: She smoothed the creases from her skirt.
examples.zh: 她捋平裙子上的皺褶。

examples.en: I’ll have to iron out the creases.
examples.zh: 我得把皺褶熨平。

examples.en: a job creation scheme
examples.zh: 創造就業機會的計劃

examples.en: The commissioner presented his credentials to the State Department.
examples.zh: 該委員向國務院遞交了他的任職資格證書。

examples.en: Her excuse was barely credible.
examples.zh: 她的藉口無法讓人信服。

examples.en: a credible alternative to nuclear power
examples.zh: 原子能的可靠替代物

examples.en: small creatures that hide in crevices in the rock
examples.zh: 藏在岩石縫裡的小生物

examples.en: Construction had slowed because of a dearth of labourers.
examples.zh: 建築程序緩慢是因為勞動力不足。

examples.en: She was hit by flying debris from the blast.
examples.zh: 她被爆炸產生的飛散碎片擊中。

examples.en: She studied the envelope, trying to decipher the handwriting.
examples.zh: 她仔細地看信封，試圖辨認上面的字跡。

examples.en: The buildings were in a decrepit state.
examples.zh: 這些建築物破舊不堪。

examples.en: He was a rather decrepit old man.
examples.zh: 他年老體弱。

進階.zh: 獻身的，一心一意的，熱誠的

examples.en: a dedicated and thoughtful teacher
examples.zh: 一位富有敬業精神、待人體貼的教師

examples.en: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
examples.zh: 該公司的財務困境令潛在的投資者望而卻步。

examples.en: ...a brand of detergent.
examples.zh: …一種品牌的清潔劑。

examples.en: The two men detested each other.
examples.zh: 兩個男人互相厭惡。

examples.en: Work hard to succeed but not to the detriment of others.
examples.zh: 在不損害他人利益的前提下為成功艱苦奮鬥。

examples.en: A “do what I say, not what I do” world economy will fracture, to the detriment of all.
examples.zh: 在一個“依我所言，勿仿我行”的世界裡，世界經濟將割裂分化，傷害所有的國家。

examples.en: the detrimental effect of pollution on the environment
examples.zh: 汙染對環境的不利影響

examples.en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.
examples.zh: 他正在寫一篇關於索馬利亞內戰的論文。

examples.en: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas.
examples.zh: 透過此切口，二氧化碳氣體把胸腔充得腫脹起來。

examples.en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987.
examples.zh: 這瓶威士忌是1926年被蒸餾的，存放至1987年釀造成熟。

examples.en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
examples.zh: 他感到歡欣鼓舞，而且喝得有點醉了。

examples.en: Fashion is by nature ephemeral.
examples.zh: 從本質上說，時尚不過是一時的潮流。

examples.en: an equitable distribution of food supplies
examples.zh: 所供應食品的合理分配

進階.zh: 公平；公正；無固定利息的股票

examples.en: a society run on the principles of equity and justice
examples.zh: 以公平、正義為原則的社會

examples.en: His answer was equivocal.
examples.zh: 他的回答模稜兩可。

examples.en: She was rather equivocal about her work.
examples.zh: 她談到她的工作時有點含糊其詞。

examples.en: an attempt to eradicate inflation
examples.zh: 為消除通貨膨脹所作的努力

examples.en: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
examples.zh: 這個問題現已徹底杜絕。

進階.zh: 古怪的，反覆無常的，不穩定的

examples.en: His breathing was becoming erratic.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸越來越不均勻。

examples.en: his erratic behaviour
examples.zh: 他難以捉摸的行為

examples.en: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
examples.zh: 乘電梯到4樓，左邊最後的那個辦公室就是。

examples.en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
examples.zh: 員工用毒藥來消滅鼴鼠和野兔。

examples.en: Corrupt government officials were extorting money from him.
examples.zh: 腐敗的政府官員那時正向他勒索錢財。

examples.en: So the exuberant young girl with dark hair and blue eyes decided to become a screen actress.
examples.zh: 因此，這個充滿活力的年輕黑髮碧眼女孩決定成為一名熒屏演員。

examples.en: Crystal clear waters, beautiful white sand beaches, swaying palm trees and fabulous dive sites – that’s why the Maldives, is known for being one of the best tropical holiday destinations in the world.
examples.zh: 清澈透明的海水，美麗的白色沙灘，搖曳生姿的棕櫚樹，難以置信的的潛水勝地——這就是馬爾地夫被譽為世界上最佳熱帶地區度假地之一的原因。

examples.en: fettered by family responsibilities
examples.zh: 受家庭責任的束縛

examples.en: Insults only served to inflame the feud.
examples.zh: 侮辱只是起到了加劇長期不和的作用。

examples.en: an unpredictable and fickle lover
examples.zh: 一個捉摸不透、三心二意的情人

examples.en: the importance of marital fidelity
examples.zh: 對婚姻忠貞的重要性

examples.en: intellectually flabby arguments
examples.zh: 說不通的論據

examples.en: The band’s performance was tired and flabby.
examples.zh: 樂隊的表演有氣無力。

examples.en: As children we were taught to be frugal and hard-working.
examples.zh: 我們小時候被教育要節儉和勤勞。

examples.en: He led a remarkably frugal existence.
examples.zh: 他過著極其節儉的生活。

examples.en: Some of the current FSA investigations are expected to reach fruition in the next six months, one person said.
examples.zh: 一人說，目前正在進行的部分金融服務管理局調查有望在未來六個月完成。

examples.en: You'll learn whether or not you enjoy the work as well as improve your professional record for seeing things to fruition.
examples.zh: 你不僅可以知道自己是否喜歡這份工作，也可以因為完成任務而提高你的職業記錄。

examples.en: ...a ship with three masts and two funnels.
examples.zh: …一艘有3根桅杆和2個煙囪的輪船。

examples.en: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.
examples.zh: 他先前對爵士樂、流行樂和非洲音樂旋律的融合已經證明是非常成功的。

examples.en: ‘Morning, Albert,’ she called gaily.
examples.zh: “早安，艾伯特。”她快樂地喊道。

examples.en: a weak glimmering light
examples.zh: 微弱的閃光

進階.zh: 光澤，光滑；虛飾；註釋；加光澤於

examples.en: This gel will add gloss to even the dullest hair.
examples.zh: 用了這種髮膠，即使最乾枯的頭髮也會增添光澤。

examples.en: You could live in a homestay.
examples.zh: 也可以住在當地人家中。

examples.en: The area has a long tradition of horticulture.

儲蓄；存款；救助；節省物（saving的複數形式）

examples.en: You can enjoy a year's membership for just $28 – a saving of $7 off the regular rate.
examples.zh: 你只需花$28就可以享受一年的會員資格–比正常會費節省了$7。

examples.zh: 電腦遊戲可以提高兒童手的靈活性。

examples.en: I think that containerization is one of the best transportation methods at present.
examples.zh: 我認為是集裝箱化是當前的最佳運輸方法這一。

examples.en: Of course the shipment of goods has been changed by the technique of containerization.
examples.zh: 當然貨物裝運隨集裝箱運輸技術而改變。

examples.en: As well as this, the movie is an intriguing, if slightly loaded new perspective on the abdication crisis of 1936.
examples.zh: 除此以外，如果順帶著賦予1936年退位危機的新視角，這部電影也是很有趣的。

examples.en: But even after his abdication, he remained the effective ruler of China until his death four years later at the age of 88.
examples.zh: 即使在退位後，他仍然手握大權，直到四年後以88歲的高齡去世，一代王朝才正式落下帷幕。

進階.zh: 倉庫；停車場；航空站；把…存放在儲藏處

examples.en: the company’s distribution depot

examples.en: a fuel storage depot
examples.zh: 燃料儲存倉庫

examples.en: If there is no warning for one within half an year, the punishment of warning can be revocable;
examples.zh: 半年內無再犯警告處罰，表現良好的員工可撤銷其警告處分。

examples.en: If one is well behaved and has made great contributions to company as well within one year, the demerit recording can be revocable;
examples.zh: 一年內表現良好且為公司作出重大貢獻的可撤銷一次記過。

examples.en: ...the cultural diversity of Latin America.
examples.zh: …拉丁美洲文化的多樣性。

進階.zh: 賣主；小販；供應商；[貿易] 自動售貨機

examples.en: the shouts of street vendors
examples.zh: 街頭小販的吆喝聲

進階.zh: 舒適；禮儀；愉快；便利設施

examples.en: The hotel is in the city centre, close to shops and local amenities.
examples.zh: 該酒店位於市中心，緊鄰商店和當地的便利設施。

examples.en: houses that lack basic amenities
examples.zh: 缺乏基本生活設施的房屋

進階.zh: 人浮於事的；人員過多的

examples.en: Many workers believe the factory is overstaffed.
examples.zh: 許多工人相信該工廠人員過剩。

examples.en: ...the avoidance of stress.
examples.zh: …對壓力的避免。

examples.en: The onus is on companies and consumers to keep up with anti-virus updates.
examples.zh: 公司和使用者有責任跟上防毒軟體的更新。

examples.en: You need special authorization to park here.
examples.zh: 在此停車要有特別的許可。

examples.en: Children may not leave the building without the authorization of the principal.
examples.zh: 沒有校長的許可，孩子們不能離開這幢樓。

examples.en: Furniture and carpet retailers are among those reporting the sharpest annual decline in sales.
examples.zh: 傢俱和地毯零售商們是在那些報告最大年銷售下滑的商家之中。

進階.zh: 石牆；阻礙議程；妨礙（stonewall的ing形式）

examples.en: Gates and company were defiant, to the point of stonewalling regulators and refusing to take the charges seriously.
examples.zh: 蓋茨和公司目中無人，到了阻礙監管機構並且拒絕認真對待指控的地步。

進階.zh: 有動機的；有積極性的；使產生動機；激發…的積極性（motivate的過去式和過去分詞）

examples.en: The students are all highly motivated .
examples.zh: 學生們都有很高的積極性。

examples.en: The key to a successful modern economy is a well-educated and motivated workforce.
examples.zh: 成功的現代經濟關鍵是要有受過良好教育、積極主動的勞動力。

examples.en: Her findings have been widely disseminated .
examples.zh: 她的發現已廣為傳播。

examples.en: She set about rearranging the furniture in the living room.
examples.zh: 她開始重新擺放起居室的傢俱。

進階.zh: 必需的；（美）必修的；需要（require的過去式及過去分詞形式）；要求

examples.en: If you require further information, you should consult the registrar.
examples.zh: 如果你需要進一步的資訊，你應該向註冊主任諮詢。

examples.en: This isn't the kind of crisis that requires us to drop everything else.
examples.zh: 這不是需要我們拋下其他一切的那種危機。

examples.en: He acts as a middleman for British companies seeking contracts in the Gulf.
examples.zh: 他給在海灣地區尋找商機的英國公司當中間人。

examples.en: Buy direct from the manufacturer and cut out the middleman (= avoid using a middleman ) .
examples.zh: 從廠家直接進貨，繞開中間商。

examples.en: ...the abatement of carbon dioxide emissions.
examples.zh: ...二氧化碳排放的減少。

examples.en: ...noise abatement.
examples.zh: ...噪音的減少。

進階.zh: 先付的，已支付的；預付（prepay的過去式和過去分詞）

examples.en: The shipping charges are prepaid.
examples.zh: 運費已付。

examples.en: a prepaid envelope
examples.zh: 郵資已付的信封

進階.zh: 電腦化；電子計算機化工作

examples.en: After all these years, a human being still needs to plug in Mr. Coffee and deliver his output. But that won’t save an administrative assistant’s job from the maw of computerization.
examples.zh: 這些年來，人們還是需要自己去泡咖啡，不斷發展的計算機化也想不出辦法讓秘書們能夠節省下花在泡咖啡這樣工作上的時間。

進階.zh: 鞏固；支援；從下面支撐；加強…的基礎

examples.en: the theories that underpin his teaching method
examples.zh: 支援他的教學方法的理論

examples.en: America’s wealth is underpinned by a global system which exploits the world’s poor.
examples.zh: 美國的財富是靠一個剝削全世界窮人的全球體系來支撐的。

examples.en: the UK distributorship for Sol lighting products
examples.zh: Sol牌照明產品的英國分銷商

進階.zh: 重新評估；[經] 重新估價；重新考慮

examples.en: There's a total reassessment of what people want out of life.
examples.zh: 對於人們對生活有什麼樣的期待有了重新評價。

進階.zh: [經管] 破產管理；破產管理人的職務；破產在管

examples.en: The company went into receivership with massive debts.
examples.zh: 該公司負債累累，已經由破產管理人接管。

進階.zh: 暗機關；騙人的玩意；花招；使暗機關；搞騙人的玩意

examples.en: advertising gimmicks
examples.zh: 廣告把戲

examples.en: Sometimes you have to sacrifice efficiency for effectiveness.
examples.zh: 有時候你需要犧牲效率來達到效果。

examples.en: However, its viability and effectiveness still have to be established.
examples.zh: 然而，它的有效性和可行性尚有待驗證。

進階.zh: 分散；非集權化；（人口、工業等的）疏散
夢想的；幻影的；空想家；夢想者；有眼力的人

examples.en: Under his visionary leadership, the city prospered.
examples.zh: 在他富有遠見的領導下，這座城市蓬勃發展。

進階.zh: 尷尬的；窘迫的；使困窘；使侷促不安（embarrass的過去分詞形式）

examples.en: Lori gets embarrassed if we ask her to sing.
examples.zh: 我們要是請洛麗唱歌，她就會難為情。

examples.en: He looked embarrassed when I asked him where he’d been.
examples.zh: 我問他去了哪裡，他顯得很窘迫。

進階.zh: 即將發生的；迫切的；懸掛的；迫近；懸空（impend的現在分詞）

examples.en: On the morning of the expedition, I awoke with a feeling of impending disaster.
examples.zh: 遠征出發的那天早上，我醒來就有一種大難臨頭的感覺。

examples.en: How well do you know your chopstick etiquette?
examples.zh: 對於這些關於筷子的禮儀，你知道多少呢？

examples.en: My father progged the top of the loaves with a chopstick.
examples.zh: 我父親用一隻筷子戳刺麵包的頂部

examples.en: Student registration (= for a course of study ) starts the first week in September.
examples.zh: 學生註冊在9月份的第一個星期開始。

examples.en: The registration fee is $75.
examples.zh: 註冊費是75美元。

加重，加權；衡量；（英）生活補貼；加權；稱量（weight的現在分詞）

examples.en: salary £24,000 plus £2,400 London weighting
examples.zh: 2.4萬英鎊工資，外加2,400英鎊倫敦生活補貼

examples.en: Greenpeace has been invited to appraise the environmental costs of such an operation.
examples.zh: 綠色和平組織已受邀評估這樣一次行動對環境的影響。

examples.en: ...the cord that connects the telephone handset to the phone itself.
examples.zh: …那條連線聽筒和電話機的電線。

examples.en: industries that have been deregulated
examples.zh: 解除管制的行業

進階.zh: 衰退（經濟方面）；低迷時期

examples.zh: 美國目前經濟的衰退

examples.en: The Supreme Court has validated the lower court’s interpretation of the law.
examples.zh: 最高法院已經認可下級法院對這條法規的闡釋。

examples.en: Many scientists plan to wait until the results of the study are validated by future research.
examples.zh: 許多科學家計劃等到調查結果被今後的研究證實了以後再作定論。

進階.zh: 微分的；差別的；特異的；微分；差別

examples.en: differential rates of pay
examples.zh: 工資級差

examples.en: differential treatment of part-time and full-time staff
examples.zh: 對兼職員工和全職員工的區別對待

examples.en: The photocopier isn't printing well.
examples.zh: 這臺影印機影印效果不好。

examples.en: The mere rhythmic drone of a photocopier or the rumble from a hairdryer is enough to set her off.
examples.zh: 即使是來自影印機的細微而有節律的嗡嗡聲或吹風機的轟響都能讓她無法自已。

examples.en: She has taught her children impeccable manners.
examples.zh: 她把她的孩子教育得舉止十分得體。

examples.en: a bar with impeccable service
examples.zh: 服務無可挑剔的酒吧

進階.zh: 供應廠商，供應國；供應者

examples.en: ...one of the country's biggest food suppliers.
examples.zh: …該國最大的食品供應商之一。

examples.en: Open any of the layout templates, insert your text, make any other changes, and print.
examples.zh: 開啟任何一個設計模板，插入你的文字，做任何其他改動，然後列印。

examples.en: the pitfalls associated with the purchase of a used car
examples.zh: 購買舊車時可能遇到的圈套

進階.zh: 輕率的；不顧別人的；無謀得

examples.en: It's a bit inconsiderate of her not to let you know when she expects to arrive.
examples.zh: 她不讓你知道她什麼時候會到，這樣做有些不體諒人。

examples.en: Probe into the design principle of cipher systems irrelevant to computing power, design cipher systems with provable safety, and analyze the defects of existent cipher systems.
examples.zh: 探索與計算能力無關的密碼體制的設計原理，設計可證明安全性的密碼體制，分析現有密碼體制的缺陷。

examples.en: Good self-esteem is a prerequisite for a happy life.
examples.zh: 良好的自尊心是幸福生活的先決條件。

examples.zh: 諾瑪·瓊斯在本地一家化工廠作包裝工。

進階.zh: 電匯（Telegraphic Transfer）；總時間（Total Time）；技術術語（Technical Term）；經結核菌素試驗的（Tuberculin Tested）
廣告；廣告業；登廣告；廣告的；廣告業的

examples.en: advertising aimed at 18–25 year olds
examples.zh: 針對18到25歲人群的廣告

examples.en: a career in advertising
examples.zh: 廣告業生涯

examples.en: We’re focussing too much on irrelevant details.
examples.zh: 我們過於關注不相干的細節。

examples.en: Students viewed Latin as boring and irrelevant.
examples.zh: 學生認為拉丁語無聊且無關緊要。

examples.en: The cancer has gone into remission .
examples.zh: 癌症已經開始好轉。

examples.en: a consortium of oil companies
examples.zh: 石油公司聯合企業

examples.en: The aircraft will be built by a European consortium.
examples.zh: 這種飛機將由歐洲的一個財團建造。

examples.en: ...a self-made Irish-American property tycoon.
examples.zh: …一個靠自己奮鬥成功的愛爾蘭裔美國房地產大亨。

進階.zh: 男裝；男服；用男服料縫製的

examples.en: the menswear department
examples.zh: 男裝部

examples.en: Europe itself pays a stiff price for using this trick, in antidumping duties ultimately paid by consumers that are higher than they otherwise would be.
examples.zh: 歐盟這樣玩技巧，自己也付出了代價，因為額外高出來的反傾銷關稅部分最終還是由消費者承擔的。

examples.en: Beijing could offer additional market opening of its own in exchange for a change of Brussels antidumping policy.
examples.zh: 北京也可以向歐洲提供更多的自身市場的開放，以使布魯塞爾改變反傾銷的政策。

examples.en: The lead plaintiff of the lawsuit is the University of California.
examples.zh: 這次訴訟的第一原告是加利福尼亞大學。

examples.en: Jack and Stephen were waiting for them on the quay.
examples.zh: 傑克和斯蒂芬正在碼頭等他們。

examples.en: Some experts are concerned that the new drug won’t live up to all the hype.
examples.zh: 一些專家擔心這種新藥並不像宣傳中那麼好。

examples.en: Despite the media hype , I found the film very disappointing.
examples.zh: 儘管媒體大肆炒作，我還是覺得這部影片很讓人失望。

進階.zh: 破產；爆裂；降低階別；破產；半身像；蕭條；胸部

examples.en: The trip to Spain will probably bust our budget.
examples.zh: 這次西班牙之行可能會超出我們的預算。

進階.zh: 寬恕；免除；減輕；傳送；使恢復原狀；移交的事物

examples.en: To do this we must reorientate training for mental health specialists, ring-fence time for these activities in job contracts, and provide incentives for community engagement.
examples.zh: 要做到這點，我們必須重新定位心理衛生專業人士的培訓，在就業合同中反覆強調這些事項，併為這一共同約定提供激勵措施。

examples.en: So in order to develop private economy better, we must reorientate to the government's function, this paper has carried on the discussion on the issue.
examples.zh: 因此為了更好的發展民營經濟，我們必須對政府的職能進行重新定位，本文就針對這一問題進行了探討。

進階.zh: 自由裁量權；謹慎；判斷力；判定；考慮周到

examples.en: British newspapers no longer feel they must treat the royal family with discretion.
examples.zh: 英國報界不再覺得他們非得審慎對待王室不可了。

examples.en: Steve seemed to acquiesce in the decision.
examples.zh: 斯蒂夫看樣子默許了這個決定。

examples.en: Since its creation, the Fund has held the backing to the banknote issues of Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 外匯基金自成立以來，一直持有作為支援發行香港紙幣的資產。

examples.en: Children are often very resilient.
examples.zh: 兒童的適應力一般都很強。

examples.en: The company proved remarkably resilient during the recession.
examples.zh: 公司在經濟衰退期間表現出驚人的耐挫力。

examples.en: the changes in society engendered by the war
examples.zh: 戰爭造成的社會變化

examples.en: Society continues to idealize the two-parent family.
examples.zh: 社會依然把雙親家庭視為理想家庭。

examples.en: an idealized view of marriage
examples.zh: 理想化的婚姻觀

examples.en: Genet started as a rebel, but soon became part of the literary mainstream.
examples.zh: 熱內起初很叛逆，但不久就回歸了文學主流。

examples.en: a roofing contractor
examples.zh: 蓋屋頂的承包商

進階.zh: 徵用；要求；申請書；引渡要求；徵用；申請領取

examples.en: ...a requisition for a replacement photocopier.
examples.zh: ...一份更換影印機的授權書。

examples.en: Complete this worksheet before you decide on the model you want.
examples.zh: 在你確定課程之前，先完成這個活頁練習題。

進階.zh: 自然增長；自然增長額；收益的

examples.zh: 會計核算的方法有多種，如收付實現制核演算法、成本核演算法、權責發生制核演算法。

examples.en: The accrual method assumes that when a company makes a sale, the revenue will be received in the coming future, and it includes the sale in the accounts of the company.
examples.zh: 權責發生制基於這樣的假定，當公司銷售一批商品時，它會在將來某個時間收到這筆款項，公司賬簿中應包含這項銷售。

examples.en: They need to optimize the use of available resources.
examples.zh: 他們需要充分利用手上的資源。

進階.zh: 基準；標準檢查程式；用基準問題測試（計算機系統等）

examples.en: benchmark data
examples.zh: 基準資料

examples.en: The valuation becomes a benchmark against which to judge other prices.
examples.zh: 這個估價成了判斷其他價格的依據。

進階.zh: 革新的，創新的；新穎的；有創新精神的

examples.en: an innovative approach to language teaching
examples.zh: 創新的語言教學法

examples.en: innovative schemes for recycling waste materials
examples.zh: 廢物回收利用的創新計劃

進階.zh: 盈利能力；收益性；利益率

examples.en: a decline in company profitability
examples.zh: 公司利潤的下降

進階.zh: 自由保有；[會計] 不動產所有權

examples.en: They bought the freehold of their house.
examples.zh: 他們買下了房子的自由保有權。

進階.zh: 大肆宣傳；大吹大擂；大肆宣傳；大吹大擂

examples.en: After all the ballyhoo, the film was a flop.
examples.zh: 儘管炒作得厲害，這部電影還是不賣座。

examples.en: The power of red wine to counteract high cholesterol has been ballyhooed in the press.
examples.zh: 紅酒中和高膽固醇的功效在媒體上被誇大了。

examples.en: Mongolia seemed an unlikely candidate as the pacesetter for political change in Asia.
examples.zh: 蒙古看來不太會做亞洲政治變革的先驅。

examples.en: a stamp collector
examples.zh: 集郵者

examples.en: The painting was bought by a private collector.
examples.zh: 這幅畫被一個私人收藏家買走。

進階.zh: 流星煙火；沖天火箭；飛漲，突然高升

examples.en: The trade deficit has skyrocketed.
examples.zh: 貿易逆差已經急劇增長。

examples.en: There are huge budgetary pressures on all governments in Europe to reduce their armed forces.
examples.zh: 歐洲各國政府都面臨著巨大的裁軍預算壓力。

examples.en: See if you can rework your schedule and come up with practical ways to reduce the number of hours you're on call.
examples.zh: 看看你能否修改你的時間表，想出切實可行的方法來減少你待命的時間。

進階.zh: 期貨；未來，前途（future的複數形式）

examples.en: The spokesman said no decision on the proposal was likely in the immediate future.
examples.zh: 該發言人稱近期不太可能有有關該提案的決議。

examples.en: He was making plans for the future.
examples.zh: 他正在為將來制定計劃。

進階.zh: 宮殿似的；宏偉的；壯麗的

examples.en: a palatial country residence
examples.zh: 富麗堂皇的鄉村住宅

examples.en: ...important improvements in the situation of debtor countries.
examples.zh: …債務國境況的重大改善。

進階.zh: 以較小尺寸設計；縮小尺寸；裁減人數

examples.en: The airline has downsized its workforce by 30%.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司裁員30%。

examples.en: Were Indians “mindlessly aping” Western lifestyles more or less when India had its idiotic policy of autarky?
examples.zh: 印度自給自足的的白痴政策是多少在“盲目模仿”西方的生活方式麼？

examples.en: Pakistanis' growing sense of autarky has led them to overplay their hand in negotiations with the United States.
examples.zh: 巴基斯坦日益增強的自給自足意識使得他們在同美國談判時過高地估計了自己。

examples.en: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.
examples.zh: 在經濟增長方面一直存在急劇的減速。

examples.en: To balance the books, he raised some taxes, notably VAT, but three-quarters of the savings will come from spending cuts.
examples.zh: 為了平衡賬簿，他增加了部分稅收，特別是增值稅，但是四分之三的節餘將來自削減開支。

examples.en: A police investigation yesterday absolved the police of all blame in the incident.
examples.zh: 警方昨天的調查為其開脫了在這件事故中所有的責任。

進階.zh: 最高點；絕頂；黃金時代；極好的；第一流的

examples.en: Her hair was thick, glossy and in tiptop condition.
examples.zh: 她頭髮濃密、有光澤且髮質一流。

examples.en: If the company was to relocate, most employees would move.
examples.zh: 如果公司要遷移，大多數員工得搬家。

examples.en: The dispute is going to arbitration (=  someone is being asked to arbitrate  ) .
examples.zh: 這場爭議將提請仲裁。

examples.en: Both sides in the dispute have agreed to binding arbitration .
examples.zh: 糾紛雙方都接受了約束性仲裁。

examples.en: Deposit any random checks you get - like rebate, rewards or reimbursement checks - into this fund.
examples.zh: 把你掙的隨機錢——比如像回扣，鑑賞，或償款等——存到這個基金裡。

examples.en: I placed an order for desktop pc memory which came with a $20 MIR [mail in rebate].
examples.zh: 我訂購了一個價值20美元的桌面個人電腦儲存器，可以申請回扣的。

examples.en: Jo was tired, irritable, and depressed.
examples.zh: 喬疲憊暴躁，而且情緒低落。

進階.zh: 積聚錢財；貯藏貨物；貯藏物

examples.en: families who hoarded food during the strike
examples.zh: 罷工期間囤積食品的家庭

examples.en: We all know that most wine in restaurants is over-priced: a markup of 200 percent on cost is considered normal.
examples.zh: 我們都知道飯店中大部分葡萄酒標價過高：在成本價上漲200％被認為是正常的。

進階.zh: 不令人滿意的；不滿足的；不符合要求的

examples.en: an unsatisfactory situation
examples.zh: 讓人不滿意的狀況

進階.zh: 有義務；有責任；可說明性
清單；檢查表；備忘錄；目錄冊

examples.en: The guide contains a useful checklist of points to look for when buying a car.
examples.zh: 手冊裡有一張很有用的清單，列出買車時要注意的一些事項。

進階.zh: 定期地；有規律地；整齊地；勻稱地

examples.en: We meet regularly, once a month.
examples.zh: 我們定期見面，每月一次。

examples.en: The timescale for completing the work would be fairly tight.
examples.zh: 完成這項工作的時間很緊。

examples.en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
examples.zh: 每年1萬個慢性肺病患者的死亡可能是由於吸菸導致的。

進階.zh: 重新洗牌；改組；重作安排；重新洗牌；改組

examples.en: The prime minister told reporters this morning that he plans to reshuffle his entire cabinet.
examples.zh: 首相今晨告訴記者們他計劃改組全體內閣。

進階.zh: 過多；過剩；[醫] 多血癥

examples.en: a plethora of suggestions
examples.zh: 一大堆建議

examples.en: The strongest challenger, Texas Democrat Martin Frost, has withdrawn from the race.
examples.zh: 最強勁的挑戰者，德克薩斯州的民主黨人馬丁·弗羅斯特已經退出了競選。

examples.en: He tried to pass off a false Dagas on the auctioneer.
examples.zh: 他試著把假的德加的畫賣給拍賣人。

examples.en: The most talkative is the least intelligent, and there is hardly a difference between an orator and an auctioneer.
examples.zh: 話最多的人是最不聰明的人，在一個演說家和一個拍賣人之間，幾乎沒有分別。

examples.en: The painting has been authenticated by experts.
examples.zh: 這幅畫專家鑑定為真跡。

examples.en: passwords which can authenticate electronic documents
examples.zh: 能夠驗證電子文件的密碼

進階.zh: 討價還價；交易；交涉；討價還價；交易（bargain的ing形式）

examples.en: The 4% pay raise was the result of some hard bargaining .
examples.zh: 4%的加薪是經過一番艱苦談判後才取得的結果。

examples.en: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
examples.zh: 他們更願意同個人客戶洽談，做現金交易。

進階.zh: 銀行業；銀行業務；銀行家的職業；築堤；把錢存入銀行；做銀行家；在…邊築堤（bank的現在分詞）

examples.en: the international banking system
examples.zh: 國際銀行業體制

進階.zh: 合作，協作；[勞經] 協力

examples.en: the need to strengthen international co-operation
examples.zh: 加強國際合作的需要

examples.en: Which: Identify your obstacles and strategize to overcome them.
examples.zh: 確定您的障礙所在，並制定戰略來克服這些障礙。

examples.en: Second, we will strategize on how to apply the emerging understanding so that a rapid scaling up may be possible.
examples.zh: 其次，我們將會為關於如何利用這新興的協議從而使快速的擴大成為可能制定戰略。

進階.zh: 雙語的；通兩種語言的人

examples.en: a bilingual dictionary
examples.zh: 雙語詞典

examples.en: The report proposed bilingual education in schools.
examples.zh: 報告建議在學校中實行雙語教學。

examples.en: Two managers were charged with embezzling $400,000.
examples.zh: 兩名經理被控挪用了40萬美元。

examples.en: Good ability to solve problem; good attitude for work and good energy for solidify synergic , stronger responsibility for work.
examples.zh: 有處理解決較大工藝問題的能力，有良好的工作態度和團結協作的精神。工作責任心強。

examples.en: His first office day after was in office on January 21 this year signs a memorandum, acceptance uses Internet to raise a government " diaphaneity, participate in gender and synergic sex " .
examples.zh: 他在今年1月21日執政後的首個辦公日簽署一份備忘錄，承諾利用網際網路來提高政府的“透明度、參與性和協作性”。

進階.zh: 下降，衰落；倒下；大幅度下降，暴跌；衰退；暴跌；消沉

examples.en: Sales slumped by 20% last year.
examples.zh: 去年銷售額驟減 20%。

examples.en: The council's land is now worth much less than originally hoped because of a slump in property prices.
examples.zh: 由於地產價格的暴跌，委員會的土地目前大不如原來所希望的那麼值錢了。

進階.zh: 等級；等級評定；額定功率；對…評價（rate的ing形式）

examples.en: By the end of the year the Prime Minister’s approval rating (= how many people agreed with his policies ) had fallen as low as 12 percent.
examples.zh: 到年底時，首相的支援率跌到了12%的低點。

examples.en: He acquired kudos just by appearing on television.
examples.zh: 他上電視後就出名了。

進階.zh: 撤退，收回；提款；取消；退股

examples.en: large-scale troop withdrawals
examples.zh: 大規模撤軍

examples.en: nimble fingers
examples.zh: 靈巧的手指

examples.en: a nimble climber
examples.zh: 敏捷的攀登者

進階.zh: 可提神的人或物；補習課程；清涼飲料；增加報酬；專業性複習進修的
融資；財務；籌措資金；籌措資金；財政管理；從事金融活動（finance的ing形式）

examples.en: A United States delegation is in Japan seeking finance for a major scientific project.
examples.zh: 1個美國代表團正在日本為一個重大科研專案尋求資助。

examples.en: The fund has been used largely to finance the construction of federal prisons.
examples.zh: 該基金大部分已用於資助聯邦監獄的建造。

進階.zh: 當裁判，任裁判；裁判員，仲裁人

examples.en: He umpired baseball games.
examples.zh: 他過去擔任棒球比賽的裁判。

進階.zh: 資助；給與獎助金；向…行賄

examples.en: Farming is heavily subsidized (= subsidized a lot ) by the government.
examples.zh: 農業得到政府的大量補貼。

examples.en: But if you lose your audience with technical explanations, you'll never get to what you want: a resolution so you can finalize your design.
examples.zh: 但是如果您用技術性的解釋使受眾迷惑，則您永遠得不到希望達到的目的：完成設計的解決辦法。

examples.en: Christmas has become so commercialized.
examples.zh: 聖誕節現已變得非常商業化了。

進階.zh: 要人領情的；自視高人一等的；以恩人態度自居的；光顧，惠顧；庇護，保護（patronize的現在分詞）

examples.en: a patronizing attitude
examples.zh: 自命不凡的態度

examples.en: a patronizing tone
examples.zh: 高人一等的語氣

進階.zh: 行為；離去；工作情況；地面狀況；流行的；進行中的；現存的

examples.en: His going will be no great loss to the company.
examples.zh: 他的離去對公司來說並不算多大的損失。

examples.en: That's about half the going price on world oil markets.
examples.zh: 那大約是世界石油市場上現行價位的一半。

examples.en: Nothing like that has happened in Europe — yet. But it’s certainly within the realm of possibility, especially as the pain of austerity and internal devaluation drags on.
examples.zh: 在歐洲還沒有發生這樣的事情，但肯定在可能性範疇之內，尤其是隨著財政緊縮與內部貶值痛苦的持續，這種可能會增大。

examples.en: The risk of devaluation (of the currency) does not affect them as much as it does other investors.
examples.zh: （貨幣）貶值風險對他們的影響不像對其他投資商那麼大。

examples.en: officials charged with bribery and corruption
examples.zh: 被指控受賄和貪汙的官員

examples.en: The investigation uncovered widespread corruption within the police force.
examples.zh: 這項調查揭發出了警察機關內部普遍的腐敗。

examples.en: The water sports centre will provide you with snorkelling gear and a floatation vest if you would like one.
examples.zh: 在水上運動中心將為你提供的浮淺齒輪和浮選背心，如果你想的話。

進階.zh: 繼續；續集；延長；附加部分；擴建物

examples.en: It's the coalition forces who are to blame for the continuation of the war.
examples.zh: 是聯軍應對戰爭的持續負責。

進階.zh: 不可改變的；不能取消的；不能挽回的

examples.en: Think about the situation carefully before you take an irrevocable step.
examples.zh: 在你踏出不能回頭的一步之前要三思。

進階.zh: 負面，缺點；下降趨勢；底側；底側的

examples.en: Digital cell phones offer more security, but the downside is that they have less power.
examples.zh: 數字手機安全性更好，但其劣勢在於電力不足。

examples.en: They lose their entitlement to welfare when they start work.
examples.zh: 他們開始工作時就喪失了享受福利的權利。

進階.zh: 從事於套利或套匯之人
(尤指)同院病人；同獄犯人；同被(收容所)收容者

examples.en: ...education for prison inmates.
examples.zh: …對囚犯們的教育。

進階.zh: 態度不明朗的；不承擔義務的；無明確意義的

examples.en: Mr. Hall is non-committal about the number of jobs that the development corporation has created.
examples.zh: 霍爾先生對開發公司已創造的崗位數量含糊其詞。

examples.en: Sylvia's face was noncommittal.
examples.zh: 西爾維婭的臉顯得不置可否。

進階.zh: 消減；削皮；剪；修掉（邊等）；(Pare)人名；(英)佩爾；(法)帕爾

examples.en: Pare the brown skin from the meat with a very sharp knife.
examples.zh: 用一把非常鋒利的刀削掉肉上褐色的皮。

examples.en: He took out a slab of cheese, pared off a slice and ate it hastily.
examples.zh: 他拿出厚厚的一塊乳酪，切下一片急匆匆地吃了。

進階.zh: 提取物；抽出物；精華；提取的；可萃取的；精萃的

examples.en: a car showroom
examples.zh: 汽車展廳

examples.en: They all had sticks which they planned to use as weapons.
examples.zh: 他們都持有棍棒，打算當武器用。

進階.zh: 檔案, 證明檔案, 史實, 檔案編制

examples.en: Applicants must provide supporting documentation .
examples.zh: 申請人必須提供證明檔案。

進階.zh: 扼殺；使窒息；藏匿；（馬等的）後膝關節；（馬等的）[動] 後膝關節病

examples.en: He was almost stifled by the fumes.
examples.zh: 他差點被煙燻得窒息了。

進階.zh: 意外之財；被風吹落的果子；意外的收穫

examples.en: his £2 million windfall in the lottery
examples.zh: 他彩票中獎得來的200萬英鎊意外之財

進階.zh: 自由化；自由主義化；放寬限制

examples.en: Brushing wet hair can cause stretching and breakage.
examples.zh: 梳刷溼的頭髮會導致拉抻和破損。

examples.en: Check that your insurance policy covers breakages and damage when moving.
examples.zh: 檢查你的保險是否涵蓋搬運中的破損和毀壞。

進階.zh: 資本化；資本總額；用大寫
凝聚成團；[巖] 礫岩；企業集團；聚合物

examples.en: an international conglomerate
examples.zh: 國際大型聯合企業

進階.zh: 相稱的；同量的；同樣大小的

examples.en: Employees are paid salaries commensurate with those of teachers.
examples.zh: 發給僱員的薪水與發給教師的薪水相當。

examples.en: prescriptive teaching methods
examples.zh: 規定的教學方法

examples.en: ...unsound investments that could threaten the company's solvency.
examples.zh: …可能威脅到公司償債能力的不良投資。

進階.zh: 工資單；在冊職工人數；工資名單

examples.en: They had 87,000 employees on the payroll.
examples.zh: 他們有87000人在在職人員工薪名冊上。

examples.en: They often come up for sale, but this more intimate and later artwork is quite rare and very collectable.
examples.zh: 希特勒的畫作常被拍賣，但這張卡片顯得更為親切，並且非常罕見，收藏價值很高。

examples.en: Among other things, the collector examines the class loader data structures to determine which classes are live -- that is, are not garbage collectable.
examples.zh: 在眾多的事情當中，收集器檢查類裝入器的資料結構，來判斷哪個類是活動的 —— 也就是說，不應當被當作垃圾收集的。

進階.zh: 阻止；排除；取消抵押品贖回權

examples.en: The bank foreclosed on the mortgage for his previous home.
examples.zh: 銀行取消了他先前住房的抵押贖回權。

examples.en: The contract that was signed on Thursday morning was backdated to March 11.
examples.zh: 星期四上午所籤的合同從3月11日起生效。

examples.en: Shareholders have been told to expect an even lower result next year.
examples.zh: 股東們被告知明年的業績還會更差。

examples.en: an Internet service provider
examples.zh: 因特網服務供應商

進階.zh: 無所不能的；全能的；有無限權力的

examples.en: Doug lived in the shadow of his seemingly omnipotent father.
examples.zh: 道格生活在他那看似無所不能的父親的陰影裡。

進階.zh: 可固定的；可確定的；可裝置的
收件人，收信人；[計] 被訪地址

examples.en: Who is the addressee?
examples.zh: 收件人是誰？

examples.en: Although the addressee of Sergeant Keeler's letter is unknown, it seems clear it was written to a family member, with the intent that it would be shared.
examples.zh: 雖然基勒中士的信件收信人無人知曉，不過看起來顯然是寫給家族成員的，有希望被大家分享的心情。

進階.zh: 危險的；冒險的；（作品等）有傷風化的

examples.en: Doctors say it’s too risky to try and operate.
examples.zh: 醫生說動手術風險太大。

examples.en: Buying a secondhand car is a risky business .
examples.zh: 買二手汽車是有風險的。

進階.zh: 搖晃的；不可靠的；不堅定的

examples.en: a shaky voice
examples.zh: 顫抖的聲音

examples.en: Grandad was a little shaky on his feet (= not able to walk very well ) .
examples.zh: 爺爺走路有點晃晃悠悠。

進階.zh: [計] 處理器；處理程式；加工者

examples.en: US tuna processors
examples.zh: 美國的金槍魚加工廠商

進階.zh: 俯衝；暴跌；突然變壞；（價格等的）急降，暴跌；（飛機的）俯衝；（名聲）低落；（情況）突然變壞

examples.en: The value of other shares nosedived by $2.6 billion.
examples.zh: 其他股票市值暴跌了26億美元。

進階.zh: [自] 調節器；調停者；（保險等）理算員

examples.en: ...a seat belt adjuster.
examples.zh: …一個座椅安全帶調節器。

examples.en: Toohey is the exception: he is the one character in Rand's work who fully comprehends the difference between good and evil, between individualism and collectivism, and consciously chooses evil.
examples.zh: 圖希是個例外：他是蘭德作品裡一個徹底理解善與惡的區別，個人主義與集體主義的區別，並刻意選擇為惡的角色。

examples.en: "Smaller countries tend to be a little happier because there is a stronger sense of collectivism and then you also have the aesthetic qualities of a country, " White said.
examples.zh: 懷特指出：“小國家的人民有更加幸福的趨勢，因為這些國家的人有更強烈的集體主義感，以至於他們會注意到這個國家的優勢。”

examples.en: the disproportionate amount of money being spent on defence
examples.zh: 比例失衡的國防開支

examples.en: Only a short campaign took place in Puerto Rico, but after the war Spain ceded the island to America.
examples.zh: 波多黎各島僅經歷了一場短暫的戰鬥，但大戰後西班牙把該島割讓給了美國。

examples.en: ...infringement of privacy.
examples.zh: …對隱私的侵犯。

examples.en: The United Mine Workers are not on strike today, despite the expiry of their contract at midnight.
examples.zh: 聯合礦業工會今天沒有罷工，儘管他們的合同於午夜期滿。

examples.en: The project was masterminded by Morris, then aged 29.
examples.zh: 這個專案由時年29歲的莫里斯策劃。

examples.en: Ridley, as commerce secretary, masterminded the privatisation.
examples.zh: 時任商務部長的裡德利策劃推行了私有化。

examples.en: ...the famous MGM logo of the roaring lion.

examples.zh: 講硬度， 金剛鑽是獨一無二的。

examples.zh: 這種方法的硬度主要取決於 CPU 中斷結構和環境轉換的硬體支援。

examples.en: aerodynamic efficiency
examples.zh: 空氣動力效率

examples.en: high standards of craftsmanship
examples.zh: 很高的工藝水準

examples.en: Next, move to the diagonal section at the back-right side of the diamond.
examples.zh: 下一個,在鑽石的背面-正確的邊移到對角線的區段。

examples.en: And then there is this group of about half a dozen right down the diagonal middle.
examples.zh: 然後有一個包含六個元素的元素組,在週期表的對角線的中部。

examples.en: These figures disproved Smith’s argument.
examples.zh: 這些資料證明史密斯的論點是錯誤的。

examples.en: Try to dress appropriately for each occasion.
examples.zh: 試圖為每個場合適當地打扮。

examples.en: Do we have any means to align our research appropriately with our understanding of those risks?
examples.zh: 我們是否有可能根據對這些風險的理解來適當地調整我們的研究方向呢？

examples.en: ...freshly baked bread.
examples.zh: …剛烤出的麵包。

examples.en: It is unbelievable, but I like that.
examples.zh: 這很難以置信，但是我喜歡它。

examples.en: The photographer uses the moving of light and excellent camera technique to create this unbelievable photo.
examples.zh: 攝影師利用光的移動和高超的攝影技術創造出這難以置信的影象。

examples.en: Recalling the talented woodworker, the finest tools are useless without the creative application of a trained and talented artisan.
examples.zh: 回到前面的木工身上，如果沒有天賦和相關的培訓，最好的工具也沒有用處。

examples.en: While it may seem harmless for the weekend woodworker to crack open a beer (or six) while working on a project, avoid the temptation until you're finished with the woodworking.
examples.zh: 雖然說，在週末木工邊幹活邊喝幾瓶啤酒看起來是沒關係的，但是在你幹完活之前，都要抵制這樣的誘惑。

進階.zh: 巴比倫人(的), 巴比倫語（的）

examples.en: It allowed Hebrew society and Judaism to strengthen for another crucial century—by which time the Babylonian king Nebuchadrezzar could banish the Hebrew people but not obliterate them or their faith.
examples.zh: 它使得希伯萊社會和猶太教在關鍵的一個世紀內不斷強大。 在這重要的時間內，巴比倫王尼布甲尼最多撒流放希伯萊人，而無法消滅他們，抑或扼殺他們的信仰。

examples.en: But in 597 and 586 B.C., the Babylonian Empire conquered the Israelites, and the Ark, at the time supposedly stored in the Temple in Jerusalem, vanished from history.
examples.zh: 但巴比倫王國分別在公元前597年和586年征服了以色列人。 據推測約櫃當時就藏於耶路撒冷的聖殿之中，之後就從歷史中煙消雲散了。

examples.en: Much of this, she says, is due to increased urbanization.
examples.zh: 而這些，主要是由於不斷增加的都市化造成的。

examples.en: These diseases are now everywhere, driven as they are by universal forces, like urbanization and the globalization of unhealthy lifestyles.
examples.zh: 現在，在城市化和不健康生活方式的全球化等普遍因素的影響下，這些疾病無處不在。

examples.en: The most densely developed areas appear white and gray, while suburban areas appear grayish green—a mixture of houses, streets, and lawns.
examples.zh: 圖中人口最稠密的發達地區呈現為白色或灰色，郊區則是由房屋、街道和草坪組成的灰綠色。

examples.en: Inside the cover someone had inscribed the words ‘To Thomas, with love’.
examples.zh: 在書的內封上，有人題寫了“托馬斯惠存”幾個字。

examples.en: intercity rivalry
examples.zh: 城市之間的競爭

examples.en: intercity trains
examples.zh: 城際火車

examples.en: Employers may become overly cautious about taking on new staff.
examples.zh: 僱主在僱用新員工的問題上可能會過於謹慎。

examples.en: We need a little something to help sometimes, to uplift us and make us feel better.
examples.zh: 我們有時需要一些事來幫助我們打起精神並且讓我們感覺好點兒。

examples.en: The new church was officially opened on July 5th.
examples.zh: 新教堂於7月5日正式啟用。

examples.en: She didn’t have the courage to admit to her deception.
examples.zh: 她沒有勇氣承認自己的欺騙行為。

examples.en: He was convicted of obtaining money by deception .
examples.zh: 他被判犯有詐騙錢財罪。

examples.en: These two buildings typify the rich extremes of local architecture.
examples.zh: 這兩座建築物代表著當地建築風格的迥異。

examples.en: Houses in the subdivision are going for astronomical prices.
examples.zh: 該小區裡的房子在以天價出售。

進階.zh: 遊隼 a外來的,移住的

examples.en: Fringe benefits here include a cigar club, the fastest lifts in the world, and the chance to snap peregrine falcons as they migrate past your no doubt hermetically sealed expanse of window.
examples.zh: 這裡的額外好處包括了一個雪茄俱樂部，世界上最快速的電梯，以及當遊隼遷徙飛過你的絕對密封的巨大玻璃窗戶時，抓住它們的機會。

examples.en: a colourful tapestry depicting a hunting scene
examples.zh: 描繪狩獵場面的彩色壁毯

examples.en: We are speeding up the mechanization of our agriculture.
examples.zh: 我們正在加快農業機械化的步伐。

examples.en: The fundamental way out for agriculture lies in mechanization.
examples.zh: 農業的根本出路在於機械化。

examples.en: He enjoyed working with clay as a sculptural form.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用黏土來做雕塑。

examples.en: Veiled beneath the Persian Gulf, a once-fertile landmass may have supported some of the earliest humans outside Africa some 75,000 to 100,000 years ago, a new review of research suggests.
examples.zh: 一項新的研究評論表明，在波斯灣的海底，也許存在過一片肥沃的土地，它曾在約75,000到100,000年前供養著除非洲大陸之外最早的人類先祖。

examples.en: "The visitors to the snow-covered landmass are endangering not just the Antarctic region by their actions, but also the rest of the world, " he said.
examples.zh: 他說，“遊客參觀冰雪覆蓋大陸的行為不僅危及到南極地區，而且危及到世界其它地區。”

examples.en: a bronze plate with gold ornamentation
examples.zh: 帶有金飾的青銅盤子

examples.en: shiny black shoes
examples.zh: 鋥亮的黑皮鞋

examples.en: a shiny polished table
examples.zh: 擦得光亮的桌子

examples.en: A glassmaker places a rounded piece of clay material on the end of a long metal stick.
examples.zh: 一個玻璃製造商的地方長的金屬棍年底的粘土材料的圓形片。

examples.en: The first documentary mention of a Venetian glassmaker is found on a deed of donation in 982 to the Benedictine monastery on the island of San Giorgio Maggiore by a Domenico.
examples.zh: 公元982年，在一份向聖•喬治•馬吉奧萊島上的本篤會修道院捐贈物品的契約中，首次提到了威尼斯的玻璃工匠。

examples.en: The terms of the contract are very unclear.
examples.zh: 合同的條款非常含糊。

examples.zh: 如今好像到處都是咖啡館。

examples.en: a French film, starring the ubiquitous Gérard Depardieu
examples.zh: 一部法國電影，由家喻戶曉的熱拉爾·德帕迪約主演

examples.zh: 埃琳娜猝然早逝之謎

examples.en: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber.
examples.zh: 他們一直在用小麥交換棉花和木材。

examples.en: nomadic herdsmen

examples.en: She takes her inspiration from shells and stones she finds on the seashore.
examples.zh: 她從她在海岸邊發現的貝殼和石頭裡獲取靈感。

examples.en: Hostility towards outsiders is characteristic of both human and nonhuman animals.
examples.zh: 敵視外來者是人類和其他動物共有的特徵。

examples.en: Measuring appeal is as exact a science as guessing the number of sweets in a jar at the fairground.
examples.zh: 對吸引力的衡量就像猜測露天遊樂場中一個罐子裡有多少糖果一樣充滿“技術性”。

examples.en: For the first time, the organisers have set aside no-smoking areas and a special area with fairground rides will be reserved for children.
examples.zh: 組織者首次劃出了無煙區，並特意為兒童留出了有旋轉木馬的遊樂場。

examples.en: Still, I sympathize with one motive behind naturalism — the aspiration to think in a scientific spirit.
examples.zh: 儘管如此，我還是支援自然主義背後的一個動機——用科學精神來思考的渴望。

examples.en: Thus naturalism becomes the belief that there is only whatever the scientific method eventually discovers, and (not surprisingly) the best way to find out about it is by the scientific method.
examples.zh: 由此，自然主義就變成了這樣的一種信仰：僅僅存在科學方法最終所作出的發現，而瞭解它的最佳途徑是透過科學方法。

examples.en: a fighting stance
examples.zh: 搏擊姿勢

examples.en: The researchers think that their biotic games could be educational to help people learn about biology, and they also think that such a forum could serve as a place to conduct real experiments.
examples.zh: 研究人員認為他們的生物遊戲有教育意義，可以幫助人們學習生物知識，他們還認為這樣的論壇可以作為進行真實實驗的場地。

examples.en: Am I suggesting that we should return to the preindustrial mode of production or to nineteenth-century "free enterprise" capitalism?
examples.zh: 我是否在建議我們應回到工業化前的生產模式或回到十九世紀"自由企業"資本主義時期呢？

examples.en: Intelligibility was enhanced, not only by the steeply raked seating, but also by the naturally low background noise of a preindustrial society.
examples.zh: 不僅是急劇傾斜的座位，前工業化社會的低背景噪音都使語音清晰度得到了提高。

examples.en: On the next page, we'll delve into the world of ethology .
examples.zh: 下面一頁我們將探究一下動物行為學的世界。

examples.en: In 1965 Goodall earned her Ph.D. in ethology from Cambridge University.
examples.zh: 1965年古道爾在劍橋大學取得了動物行為學的博士學位。

examples.en: One animal captured on video looks like a flower, covered with glasslike needles, but scientists think it is probably a carnivorous sponge.
examples.zh: 在影片中拍攝到的一種動物看上去像是朵花，覆蓋著玻璃狀的針，不過科學家認為這可能是一種食肉海綿。

examples.en: It's a hard, clear, glasslike plastic, and one of the main ingredients in that is a chemical called bisphenol A (BPA), which is an estrogen mimic.
examples.zh: 這是一種堅硬、透明、類似玻璃的塑膠。 主要材料之一是稱作雙酚A (BPA)的化學物質，與雌激素極相似。

examples.en: Dump the topsoil here.
examples.zh: 把表土倒在這裡。

examples.en: Stone is the foundation, above which is soil, and then topsoil.
examples.zh: 石頭是基礎，上面是泥土，再上面是表土。

examples.zh: ...失業、犯罪和監禁之間的相互關係。

examples.zh: 備有存款來作為急需現金時的緩衝。

examples.zh: 我是個外人，是這群人裡唯一的外國女人。

examples.en: So will corals, especially those whose skeletons are composed of aragonite, a particularly unstable form of calcium carbonate.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁對此也受到同樣的危險，對於骨骼由霰石（極不穩定的碳酸鈣）構成的珊瑚來說，情況更是如此。

examples.en: One indicator is the levels of calcium and aragonite.
examples.zh: 其中一個就是水體中的鈣和霰石的水平。

examples.en: The rest of the apartment had fortunately remained unaltered since that time.
examples.zh: 從那時起公寓的其餘部分就幸運地未曾改變過。

examples.en: Unless he was equipped with a directional microphone, he was out of earshot.
examples.zh: 除非給他配備一個定向揚聲器，否則誰也聽不見他。

examples.en: a treeless landscape
examples.zh: 寸木不生的地貌

examples.en: ...a flower seller.
examples.zh: …一個賣花的人。

examples.zh: 大部分的印度上層種姓都信奉卡莉女神。

examples.en: We announced a decision formally recognizing the new government.
examples.zh: 我們宣佈了一個決定，正式承認新政府。

examples.en: Charges had already been made against certain officials suspected of disloyalty.
examples.zh: 已對某些被懷疑有不忠行為的官員提出指控。

examples.en: Localised disease may be treated at first with relatively inexpensive drugs such as nystatin, miconazole or clotrimazole.
examples.zh: 治療區域性感染可先使用較為便宜的藥物，如制黴菌素、咪康唑或克黴唑等。

examples.en: The results of drug sensitivity showed that amphotericin (AMB) and nystatin (NYS) were the most sensitive and flucytosine (5- Fc ) was the most resistant (54.2%).
examples.zh: 藥敏結果顯示，藥物敏感性最高為兩性黴素（AMB）和制黴菌素（NYS），耐藥性最高的為5-氟胞嘧啶（54.2%）。

examples.en: This work is clearly connected with The Last Supper: the Christ has the same ethereal and elusive quality as the faded figure at the centre of Leonardo's sublime mural.
examples.zh: 這幅畫顯然和《最後的晚餐》有某種關聯：畫中的基督，和達·芬奇最偉大的壁畫中心那已褪色的基督形象一樣，同樣空靈縹緲。

examples.en: information gatherers
examples.zh: 資訊收集者

examples.en: In fact, he once took a hiatus from acting to study shoemaking.
examples.zh: 事實上，他曾經一度中斷演藝生涯跑去學習製鞋。

examples.en: Iran's main shoemaking federation also offered to supply a lifetime of shoes to Zaidi, who remains in a Baghdad jail awaiting trial.
examples.zh: 伊朗製鞋協會還向扎一迪奉送了“終身鞋”，然而扎一迪卻在巴格達一所監獄等待著審判。

examples.en: However, if the inhabitants are technologically inferior, you should find a small tribe of primitives as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 然而，如果這些居民的科技次於地球，你應該儘快找到一個小的原始部落。

examples.en: It s also the first germanium laser to operate at room temperature.
examples.zh: 這同樣也是第一速在室溫下得到控制的鍺鐳射。

examples.zh: 研究者們注射成對的電子和凹陷到鍺中。

examples.zh: 一批精美的希臘雕塑藏品

examples.zh: 雙核某種真菌中的狀態，在這種真菌中，每個菌絲體都含有兩個核，而每個核都是從不同的母體上衍生的。

examples.en: Dextrose and maltose was the best carbon source, while asparagine (Asn)was the optimum nitrogen source for both hypha growth and spore bearing.
examples.zh: 葡萄糖和麥芽糖為菌絲生長和產孢的最佳碳源。 天冬醯胺是菌絲生長和孢子產生的最佳氮源。

examples.en: Haven't farsighted economists been telling us that in the future we will work less, not more?
examples.zh: 有遠見的經濟學家們不是一直在告訴我們，將來我們會工作得更少而不是更多嗎？

examples.en: They have kept the price of sugar artificially high and so fattened the company's profits.
examples.zh: 他們一直人為地使糖價居高不下，以此為公司牟利。

examples.en: The Mandarin Oriental's pool is small in real life, suitable only for a quick dip… nothing like the vast, blue expanse of water in the marketing photo.
examples.zh: 文華東方的游泳池在現實中是很小的，只適合快速浸泡一下......一點都不像宣傳照片上那一大片寬闊的藍色水域。

examples.en: a young woman pushing a pram
examples.zh: 推著嬰兒車的年輕女子

examples.en: They got the name from Persian who in turn got it from Sanskrit, from the Indians themselves.
examples.zh: 他們從波斯人那裡得知的名字，而波斯人是依次從梵文、從印第安人他們自己得知的名字。

examples.en: An ancient Sanskrit saying says, woman is the home and the home is the basis of society. It is as we build our homes that we can build our country.
examples.zh: 一個古梵文諺語說，女人是家而家是社會的基礎就像我們能建設自己的家園我們才能建設我們的國家。

examples.en: the Earth’s orbital path
examples.zh: 地球的執行軌道

examples.en: Sixty acres of woods and ponds are home to camels, zebra, bison, water buffalo, ostrich and antelope.
examples.zh: 六十英畝的森林和池塘是駱駝，斑馬，野牛，水牛，鴕鳥和羚羊的家園。

examples.en: But the biggest obstacle is the ranchers themselves, whose cattle compete with prairie dogs and bison for grass and space.
examples.zh: 但最大的阻礙來自牧場主本身，他們的牲畜與土撥鼠和野牛們競爭著草場和空間。

examples.en: Imagine trying to balance a chest of drawers on just one of its legs, on top of a boulder, and you get an idea of what Gray gets up to.
examples.zh: 想像自己嘗試僅僅依靠衣櫃的一個腿把它平穩地放到一個大圓石上，你就知道格雷達到了什麼境界。

examples.en: For personal hygiene, Wang and her family go to a public bathhouse in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 至於個人衛生問題，王秀麗一家去附近的公共澡堂洗澡。

examples.en: After stints carrying sacks on a construction site and selling lamb kebabs in the street, she ended up as a masseuse in a public bathhouse earning $60 a month.
examples.zh: 她曾在工地搬磚，在大街上賣過羊肉串，後來成為公共澡堂的女按摩師，月收入60美元。

examples.zh: 所以如果我們可以計算出結合能，我們也可以計算出,我們需要注入多少能量到原子中,去逐出或電離一個電子。

examples.en: They were using the laser to excite and ionize the atoms liberated by the heat of the flame in order to measure the characteristic emissions of different flames.

examples.zh: ...一家好萊塢大製片廠。

examples.zh: 這種藥物是直接注射到血液中的。

examples.zh: 飛機在空中相撞。
